pages.title: Quillmere Ridge Half Marathon: race-morning schedule
pages.text:
Published by the Quillmere Ridge Running Association for Sunday, November 8, 2026.

All entrants pass bag and security screening at their assigned gate.
Gate B opens at 5:30 AM and Gate D opens at 5:45 AM.
Each gate is about a 5-minute walk from the start corrals.

| Wave | Gate | Suggested gate arrival | Corral closes | Start |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | B | 5:45 AM | 6:40 AM | 6:50 AM |
| 2 | B | 6:00 AM | 6:55 AM | 7:05 AM |
| 3 | D | 6:15 AM | 7:10 AM | 7:20 AM |
| 4 | D | 6:30 AM | 7:25 AM | 7:35 AM |

Be inside your corral at least 10 minutes before it closes.
Runners who miss their corral start at the back of the final wave.

pages.title: Quillmere Ridge Half Marathon course map
pages.text:
The Quillmere Ridge Half Marathon starts on Harbor Row, climbs the ridge road to the reservoir, and returns along the lakefront path to finish at Fountain Square.
Water stations are at miles 2, 5, 8, and 11.
The course is closed to traffic until 11:30 AM.

pages.title: Race-morning forecast: Quillmere Ridge Half Marathon
pages.text:
Expect a cool, dry start for the Quillmere Ridge Half Marathon, around 8°C at dawn and rising to 13°C by late morning.
Light wind from the lake; no rain is expected.

pages.title: Race-day security screening tips
pages.text:
Most big races now screen every runner at the gate.
Use a clear bag, keep your bib visible, and leave prohibited items at home.
Lines can be hard to predict, so build in a buffer before your corral closes.

pages.title: Pellbrook Basin 10K 2025: entry lines
pages.text:
Posted by marlow_strides after the 2025 Pellbrook Basin 10K.

I arrived at Gate 2 at about 7:00 AM and the security line took around 15 minutes.
Friends who came through Gate 1 said it was quicker.

pages.title: Quillmere Ridge Half 2025: parking and shuttle notes
pages.text:
Posted by trailmole after the 2025 race.

The Linden Street garage was full by about 6:00 AM.
The shuttle from the Fairgrounds lot ran every 10 minutes from 5:00 AM and dropped us a block from the gates.
Bag pickup at the finish was quick once I found the right tent.

pages.title: Quillmere Ridge Half 2025: smooth morning at Gate B
pages.text:
Posted by northfield_jo after the 2025 race.

Wave 1 here, entering through Gate B.
I arrived at 5:50 AM and got through security in under 5 minutes.

pages.title: Quillmere Ridge Half 2023: the Gate D line
pages.text:
Posted by kestrel_pace after the 2023 race.

I was in Wave 4 and arrived at Gate D at about 6:40 AM.
The security line was long: I waited roughly 35 minutes to get in, and reached my corral with only a couple of minutes to spare.
